name: Linden House
description: An old brick apartment building on Linden Street. The stairs creak, the walls are thin and everyone knows everyone. Your new home.

name: Corner Café
description: A small, warm café on the corner of Linden Street. It smells of coffee and cinnamon, and the regulars all know Mia by name.

name: Bright Path Travel
description: A friendly travel agency in the city centre, with maps on the walls and a busy front desk. They are looking for a new customer assistant.
